subject: One-time commercial accommodation request for SpruceHealth due to private deployment timing
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: One-time commercial accommodation request for SpruceHealth due to private deployment timing

Team —

Quick summary: SpruceHealth (Pilot / commercial) just confirmed they cannot go live on the Private deployment on their originally planned onboarding date (Dec 15) because of a third-party network appliance compatibility issue. Product has flagged the work as a roadmap slip (PV-1729) and estimates the Private connector fix will be available ~mid-Jan. Customer is asking for a commercial make-good to keep the launch moving.

Attachments: launch-impact-summary.xlsx (spreadsheet), Spruce-SOW-draft.pdf (pdf) — both attached for context.

Ask: I want to propose a one-time accommodation (credit + waived onboarding fee) to preserve the relationship and keep momentum. Need quick confirmation on: 1) product mitigation / ETA, 2) commercial sizing (recommended credit amount), and 3) whether finance/legal alignment needed for approval.

Context for product: Spruce is sensitive about routing data off their VPC; we offered a short-term hosted routing with strict retention + encryption but they are hesitant. Karthik, can you confirm whether the hosted fallback is viable as a temporary path and the risk profile?

Marissa — any suggested commercial ask that would be persuasive but not open-ended? Marcus/Aditya — please chime on approval path.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

---
(Attachment stubs included: launch-impact-summary.xlsx, Spruce-SOW-draft.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: One-time commercial accommodation request for SpruceHealth due to private deployment timing

Hannah / Marissa —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick product read: the Private VPC connector regression is tied to a kernel-level networking change in the connector agent that impacted a subset of third-party appliances (PV-1729). Engineering has a patch ready; QA validated the core fix yesterday. My estimate: patch to staging by 2026-12-10, production rollout ~2026-01-12 after extended validation and a small ops window.

Hosted fallback: technically feasible, but requires an isolated tenant + strict retention policy and customer consent. From a data-security standpoint it’s lower risk if we apply per-customer KV rotation and ensure no long-term logs. Legal will want an explicit exception.

Recommended mitigation plan to present to Spruce: 1) Temporary hosted route with per-customer encryption keys + delete-on-confirmation, 2) Waive onboarding fee, 3) One-time service credit while fix ships.

Estimate the customer impact window at ~4–6 weeks if we go hosted fallback, or ~6 weeks if they wait for Private. Happy to join a call with Spruce to explain tradeoffs.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP Product — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: One-time commercial accommodation request for SpruceHealth due to private deployment timing

Hannah / team —

From the field: Spruce is in active procurement and has a 90-day window to sign the SOW. If we can offer a clear mitigation + a modest commercial sweetener they will commit now and push the Private deployment to the Jan cycle. If we punt the ask to legal/finance without a proposed number, we risk losing the deal to a competitor.

My commercial proposal (conservative):
- One-time credit equivalent to $50k applied to first invoice after go-live (or earlier as a rebate).
- Waive the $12k onboarding fee.
- Offer an optional 25% discounted rate for the first 30 days of usage if they choose hosted fallback (to mitigate migration churn).

This package is framed as timeboxed and conditional on: signed addendum (SOW update) and the hosted fallback opt-in or documented acceptance to wait for Private timeline.

I can present this on the call with Elena next week if we get quick approval. HubSpot deal: SPR-2026-042 (link: https://app.hubspot.com/meetings/SPR-2026-042).

–Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(Attachment referenced: Spruce-SOW-draft.pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: One-time commercial accommodation request for SpruceHealth due to private deployment timing

Folks —

Finance is fine with evaluating a one-time credit but we need the following before any approval:
1) Simple three-line P&L impact (total credit, expected offset via committed usage or ancillary fees).
2) A signed MSA/SOW addendum that captures the timebox and the condition for the credit (e.g., credit only applied if they sign by Dec 20 or choose hosted fallback).
3) Legal sign-off on the hosted-fallback data controls (I need the exact retention & key rotation language).

If you can provide the spreadsheet with credit math and the proposed addendum language I will fast-track to CFO review. Marcus will not gate the deal if the economics are modest, but we need traceability for audit.

Attachment: launch-impact-summary.xlsx looks close — please add a tab with the credit scenario and a note on how it will be recognized.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
